title: The Flea Pits in Paris and Jenkins at Club Daunou
summary: Returning to Paris, Briggs found Edmund Jenkins leading a jazz band at the fashionable Club Daunou and met at the musicians' cafe called the Flea Pits.

story.theme_name: Gangsters, bootleggers and rough clubs of Prohibition
story.community_name: Cabarets, honky-tonks and the Storyville nightlife scene

blocks.x: So, I came back -- I said, "I'm going to avoid Belgium, if possible, 'cause I don't like what happened," but the funniest thing is I came back and I saw Mr. Jenkins --
No, no, I came back, I came back.
Yes, and I saw my friend Edmund Jenkins who was at the Club Dauroup, very fashionable club.
What kind of a band was that?
What kind of a band was that?
And did you know that he was there?
You didn't even know he was in Paris.
I did not know that he was in Paris, but we had a meeting place of musicians, you see.
That was on the Rue, on the corner of the Rue Labriere and Rue Pigalle. It was called the "Flea Pits".
The cafe is still there. The musicians (Laughter).
And that's where I saw Mr. Jenkins, and I told him I had just come back. He was surprised. He said, 'What's happening?' So, I told him more or less what's happening, on the other side.
He said, 'Well, look,' he said, 'I'm at the Club Danroup, and if you're not doing anything, you can work with me,' until you find something of your own, or something, you know.'
